evidence_boundary: SW2-05 acceptance covers Schema & Toolchain Versioning only: profile/spec schema versions, auditable toolchain identity, deterministic supported migrations, and release compatibility policy. SW2-01 through SW2-04 accepted governance, performance, sequence, and documentation guarantees are inherited authority and must not be weakened. Runtime/E2E is not applicable to this repository phase unless implementation introduces behavior requiring stronger runtime evidence.

requirements.evidence: NOT_PROVEN until version contracts are implemented across profile/spec parsing, templates, and validation with compatibility regression evidence.
requirements.requirement: Profile and governed specification schemas expose explicit, auditable versions.

requirements.evidence: NOT_PROVEN until a deterministic toolchain lock/identity contract is implemented and validated against vendored consumer tooling.
requirements.requirement: Skill Workflow toolchain identity is lockable and auditable by consumer projects without making mutable cache state authoritative.

requirements.evidence: NOT_PROVEN until migration commands/contracts and positive plus tamper/unsupported-version regressions exist.
requirements.requirement: Supported schema/toolchain migrations are deterministic, explicit, and regression-tested fail closed.

requirements.evidence: NOT_PROVEN until compatibility policy is source-authored, linked from public reference documentation, and validated against implemented version/migration behavior.
requirements.requirement: Release compatibility policy documents supported versions, migration expectations, and incompatible-change handling.
